newActualCampaign.qualification: One actual cold continuous native session. Native current-witness binding and resource-bounded abstention are explicit extensions; this is not complete original-caller parity or a full-game WIN.

preservedFailuresAndDiagnostic.qualification: Initialization failure, strict uniqueness refusal, OOM and the fourth active-time-budget failure are preserved separately. The instrumented journal ends after sixteen acquired public returns and two levels, with no final success report. Its reduction invariants do not prove a one-peg goal impossible. The fourth target-three campaign remains failed after seventy-seven acquired actions and two levels.

coldStartDiagnostic.qualification: Read-only initial planning on the published v51 bytes. It proves neither an effect nor a completed level.

componentComparisons.qualification: Both Python comparators are recomputed unchanged without a game or native execution. Strict source proposals remain explicit counterfactuals; actual proposals and guards may use separately declared native questions. Original acquisitions, independent native annex acquisitions and qualified identities are checked in their stated domains without promoting a native extension to source parity.

independentExtensionContracts.qualification: Separate frozen helper comparisons of actual retained public inputs. Their restored checkpoint queries validate component construction and guards, never a new cold campaign or a solved level.

deltaTests.qualification: One frozen targeted execution; counts and unique scoped identities are recomputed from the retained complete TAP log. This is not the historical full suite.

regressions.qualification: Eight cold native recalculations consume previously retained complete public returns. They are regressions, not eight new live victories or speed comparisons.

browser.qualification: Seven observed desktop samples have identical document rectangles with inspection closed. This is not per-frame, fullscreen or mobile validation.

preservedTypedPrioritySnapshot.qualification: The retained first typed-prerequisite priority implementation regresses to one completed level and fails at103 actions. preservedPrePhasedSnapshot.qualification: The precedence correction restores two completed levels but the actual cold campaign still fails after eighty-six acquired actions.
